setting: Early autumn 1620, weeks after the Polish-Lithuanian defeat at Cecora. The lower Dnipro and the Wild Fields: reed and bulrush plavni along the river, russet dried feather-grass steppe with low hills and ravines, a recently burnt copse with blackened pole-like trunks and cold ash over a hidden brook between cart-sized boulders, high rocky river cliffs, a labyrinth of reedy straits and willow islands, a hidden riverside clearing with a Cossack earthen dugout cabin (zemlyanka), a deep oak ravine with mossy boulders and a healer-hermit's earth cabin, and a secret cove behind a massive boulder under sheer cliffs where the band winters. Boats: small wooden dugout canoes and long chaikas with reed bundles lashed along the sides. Firearms are matchlock samopal muskets (1620); a small hidden cannon in a hillside.

characters.dmytro: Dmytro, 24-year-old Ukrainian Cossack from Bila Tserkva escaped from Tatar captivity, lean and gaunt, sunburnt hollow-cheeked face, grey-blue eyes, shaved head grown out to short stubble with a light-brown forelock, thin dark-blond drooping mustache, a few days' stubble, torn off-white linen shirt, faded patched dark-blue sharovary, frayed red sash, worn brown leather boots
characters.dmytro_in_tatar_coat: Dmytro, 24-year-old Ukrainian Cossack escaped from Tatar captivity, lean and gaunt, sunburnt hollow-cheeked face, grey-blue eyes, light-brown forelock, thin dark-blond drooping mustache, a few days' stubble, wearing a captured brown Tatar sheepskin cap and a worn ochre quilted Tatar kaftan over a torn linen shirt, faded dark-blue sharovary, worn brown boots, a curved Tatar sabre on his belt, Tatar composite bow and leather quiver
characters.tatar_sleeper: Crimean Tatar warrior, about 35, round wind-burnt face, high cheekbones, sparse black mustache and thin chin beard, brown sheepskin cap, faded ochre quilted kaftan with a leather belt, soft leather boots
characters.tatar_raiders: Crimean Tatar raiders, weathered steppe men of varied ages in quilted kaftans of brown, ochre and dull green, sheepskin and fur caps, composite bows and quivers, curved sabres, short spears, small shaggy steppe horses
characters.dmytro_horse: small sturdy bay steppe stallion with a dark shaggy mane and thick neck, Tatar wooden saddle on a felt pad, simple rawhide bridle
characters.otaman: the otaman of the Cossack fishermen, about 50, short and wiry, simply dressed, a pale old sabre scar covering the left half of his face from brow to jaw, grey drooping mustache, shaved head with a grey forelock, short clay pipe between his lips, plain grey wool zhupan, undyed linen shirt, black sash, sabre at his side
characters.stepan: Stepan from Bila Tserkva, about 26, lively handsome face with a quick confident smile, dark eyes, black forelock, neat black drooping mustache, clean-shaven chin, dark-green zhupan over a white linen shirt, red sharovary, yellow leather boots, crimson sash with a wheel-lock pistol, good sabre, kalpak trimmed with black lambskin
characters.fisherman_gunman: Cossack fisherman guard, about 40, sun-darkened weathered face, thick brown drooping mustache, shaved head with a dark forelock, patched linen shirt with rolled sleeves, faded brown sharovary, rope belt under a sash, long matchlock samopal musket with a smoldering match cord
characters.fisherman_spearman: young Cossack fisherman, about 22, lanky and sunburnt, sandy forelock, wispy mustache, bare-headed, coarse linen shirt and grey sharovary, barefoot, long spear, sabre at his hip
characters.stocky_accuser: stocky Cossack fisherman, about 45, barrel-chested, red weathered face, bushy black mustache, black forelock, sleeveless sheepskin vest over a dirty linen shirt, holding a long pole with a rope noose at its end
characters.cossack_fishermen: the band of Zaporozhian Cossack fishermen, weathered sunburnt men of varied ages, shaved heads with forelocks or cropped hair, long drooping mustaches, patched linen shirts, faded wool sharovary in blue, brown and dark green, wide sashes, sabres, matchlock muskets and bows, some fur kalpaks
characters.ustym: Ustym, about 40, short and broad-shouldered, square stubbled face, brown drooping mustache, cropped brown hair under a brown felt kalpak, brown wool zhupan with rolled sleeves, blue sharovary, wide orange sash, sabre and bow, axe at his belt
characters.ohrim: Ohrim, about 35, tall and quiet, long thoughtful face, deep-set eyes, long black drooping mustache, shaved head with a long black forelock tucked behind the ear, dark-blue zhupan, grey sharovary, black sash, long matchlock musket
characters.ivan: Ivan, about 30, former tinsmith, wiry and energetic, freckled ruddy face, reddish-brown forelock, short ginger mustache, sharp nose, linen shirt under a leather vest, dark-green sharovary, red sash, sabre and bow, coil of rope over his shoulder
characters.blackthorn: Blackthorn (Teren), tall elderly hermit-healer, about 70, gaunt, long grey-white beard and mustache, bushy eyebrows, piercing pale eyes, long grey hair, shabby faded Cossack zhupan patched many times, large carved wooden cross on a cord at his chest, clay pipe in his mouth, leaning on a long rohach boar spear like a bishop's staff
characters.wounded_cossacks: two badly wounded Cossacks lying on improvised plank litters, pale drawn faces, one conscious with open eyes, bodies covered with their coats, clean linen bandages
characters.sledge_horse: docile grey-dun working horse with a rough harness of ropes and old belts

notes: Costume continuity by branch: on the root page and in branches r.0.1, r.0.0.1 and r.1 Dmytro wears his torn captive clothes (key dmytro); from r.0 he carries the Tatar composite bow, quiver and knapsack, and in r.1.* also a captured curved Tatar sabre. In branch r.0.0.0.* (he shot the tracking Tatar) he wears the dead man's sheepskin cap and ochre quilted kaftan with the Tatar sabre (key dmytro_in_tatar_coat), which is why the fishermen take him for a spy. The interrogator in the dugout cabin and the otaman in the tent are the same scarred man. Dmytro's boat is a small wooden dugout canoe; the band uses dugouts plus a long reed-lashed chaika. Firearms are matchlocks. Violence implied only: fallen figures seen small and far, half-hidden by grass or smoke; dead Cossacks laid in a respectful row covered by coats; no blood. The 'young lady underwater' is never shown.
cover_palette: Early-autumn Wild Fields: russet and straw-gold dried steppe grass, ash grey and charcoal of the burnt forest, yellowing willow green and fading olive reeds, steel-blue and pewter Dnipro water, ochre and brown wool and leather, rust and gold oak leaves; leaden overcast skies, low copper sunsets, warm amber ember and candle light at night.
